elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 10.4 instead provides that all writings and works of authorship created by M&I while performing the Services are M&I's property.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: No assignment to Customer is provided; M&I expressly retains ownership of Developed Software.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 17.2 leaves Customer with no rights in M&I's software, systems, documentation, procedures, and related materials except for the stated licences.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Section 10.5 makes the Developed Software licence perpetual, but does not expressly cover pre-existing Vendor IP embedded in that software.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The irrevocable licence applies to Developed Software, not expressly to pre-existing Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The royalty-free licence applies to Developed Software, not expressly to pre-existing Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 17.1 states that Customer remains the sole and exclusive owner of all Customer Data.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Section 17.4 permits use for any 'purposes contemplated by this Agreement,' which is not expressly limited solely to processing Customer Data to provide the Services.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The provisions allocate Developed Software solely to M&I and Customer Data solely to Customer, without creating joint ownership.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: Section 10.4 provides that M&I retains sole ownership of its programs, ideas, know-how, and concepts.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Section 10.5 expressly grants a perpetual licence to Developed Software.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Section 10.5 expressly grants an irrevocable licence to Developed Software.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: Section 10.5 expressly grants a worldwide licence to Developed Software.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Section 10.5 expressly grants a royalty-free licence to Developed Software.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Section 10.5 permits Customer to use and modify Developed Software for Customer's business.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Section 10.5 permits Customer to sublicense Developed Software for Customer's business.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Section 17.4 authorizes use for the broader 'purposes contemplated by this Agreement,' rather than solely to process Customer Data to provide the Services.
